title: Backup Manager
subtitle: View all domain backups from a single place; daily automatic backup runs, S3/SFTP targets are configured per domain.

schedule.label: 🕒 Automatic backup:
schedule.auto_retention_range: last {{min}}–{{max}} automatic backups kept (varies by domain)
schedule.manual_retention_range: last {{min}}–{{max}} manual backups kept (varies by domain)

cleanup.title: Bulk Backup Cleanup
cleanup.desc: Retention limits only apply going forward — use this to clear backups that have already piled up. Deleted backups cannot be recovered.
cleanup.confirm_oto: {{count}} AUTOMATIC backups ({{size}}) across {{domains}} domains will be permanently deleted. Manual backups are not affected. This cannot be undone.
cleanup.confirm_manuel: {{count}} MANUAL backups ({{size}}) across {{domains}} domains will be permanently deleted. Automatic backups are not affected. This cannot be undone.
cleanup.confirm_gun: {{count}} backups ({{size}}) older than the last {{days}} days, across {{domains}} domains, will be permanently deleted. Both automatic and manual backups are included. This cannot be undone.

auto.title: All automatic backups
auto.desc: Deletes every backup taken by the scheduler. Your manual backups stay in place.

manual.title: All manual backups
manual.desc: Deletes every backup taken by hand via "Create Backup". Scheduled backups stay in place.

days.title: Backups older than a given age
days.desc: Deletes every backup older than the number of days you choose — automatic and manual alike.

info_note_after: . Even if a domain is deleted, its backups are preserved (accidental-deletion recovery). For single-backup download/restore/target settings, go to "{{manage}}".

bulk.started: Backup started for {{count}} domains — progress below.
bulk.progress_other: Another user's bulk backup is running: {{done}} / {{total}}
bulk.done: Bulk backup complete — {{ok}} domains backed up.
bulk.errors_title: Domains that could not be backed up
